title: Referrals & Prior Authorizations Held by One Patient: No Overall Cap
content:
A patient of Linden Ridge Medical Group may hold any number of Referrals & Prior Authorizations cases across specialties and services over time. There is no overall cap on the number of referrals and authorizations one patient holds.

How many cases may be open at the same time for one specialty, and how a request that overlaps an existing case is treated, is governed by the group's rule on open and overlapping referrals for one specialty; the absence of an overall cap does not lift that rule.

## Points of judgement

- *A patient already holds a cardiology referral, a physical therapy authorization and an imaging authorization. Does the number held stop a new referral for dermatology?* No. Across specialties and services there is no overall cap.
- *Is there a lifetime or yearly limit on referrals for one patient?* No overall limit of any kind is set; referrals held over time are not capped.
